question.text: A 1-day VaR of Rs. 1 cr at 95% scales to a 10-day VaR approximately by:

explanation.text: The Logic: The VaR formula uses daily standard deviation multiplied by the square root of the number of days, so a 10-day VaR scales the 1-day figure by √10 (≈ Rs. 3.16 cr). The Trap: Linear scaling (×10) overstates the multi-day VaR; no scaling ignores the time dimension altogether. Note: The result depends on the underlying VaR formula used by the manager.
